About PharmaACE


PharmaACE is a global life sciences consulting, analytics, and technology firm headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with a strong presence across the US, Europe, and India. We partner with leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare organizations, combining deep domain expertise with advanced analytics, data science, cloud, BI, and AI capabilities to deliver high-impact solutions. Our services span market research, commercial, patient and payer analytics, forecasting, competitive intelligence, management consulting, enterprise transformation, and AI-enabled solutions, including our proprietary PACE platforms. We support clients across the product lifecycle and therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Immunology, CNS, CV-Met, and Rare Diseases. Today, PharmaACE is a 1000+ member organization recognized globally for solving complex healthcare challenges through insight, innovation, and collaboration.


What You'll Work On


1. Design and execute pharmaceutical market access and pricing analytics projects, including payer

landscape assessments, formulary positioning analyses, and access barrier evaluations

2. Develop drug pricing strategies by analyzing competitive benchmarks, therapeutic value,

willingness-to-pay thresholds, and payer reimbursement dynamics

3. Build and maintain pharma-specific pricing models, including gross-to-net (GTN) models,

rebate/discount simulations, and revenue forecasting across commercial and government payer

4. Support product launch and lifecycle pricing strategy, including price corridor assessment,

international reference pricing considerations, and competitive price positioning

5. Conduct formulary and reimbursement analyses, evaluating tier placement, step edits, prior

authorization requirements, and their impact on product uptake

6. Perform contracting and rebate scenario modeling to assess trade-offs between access, pricing,

and profitability

7. Analyze real-world evidence (RWE) to understand patient journeys, treatment patterns,

adherence, and switching behavior from an access and pricing perspective

8. Work with pharma datasets (claims, patient-level data, specialty pharmacy data, formulary

databases) using SQL, Python, or SAS9. Develop health economic and outcomes insights (e.g., cost-effectiveness inputs, resource

utilization) to support value-based pricing and payer negotiations

9. Develop health economic and outcomes insights (e.g., cost-effectiveness inputs, resource

utilization) to support value-based pricing and payer negotiations

10. Create client-ready deliverables, including strategic recommendations, executive presentations,

and technical documentation

11. Build interactive dashboards (Tableau/Power BI) to track access metrics, pricing performance, and

payer coverage

12. Collaborate with global client teams, including market access, HEOR, and commercial strategy

stakeholders, to align analytics with product strategy 

13. Act as a subject matter expert in pharmaceutical pricing and market access, mentoring junior team

members and supporting capability building

14. Serve as a key client contact, ensuring high-quality delivery and strong stakeholder engagement


Requirements

1) Bachelor’s/Master’s degree with 4–8 years of

experience in pharmaceutical consulting, HEOR, pricing,

or market access.

2) Strong understanding of the U.S. pharmaceutical

market, payer landscape, reimbursement, and market

access strategies.

3) Experience with drug pricing, rebates, formulary

management, product launches, and competitive

intelligence.

4) Proficiency in Excel, SQL, Python, and/or SAS with

experience working on claims, formulary, and patient

level datasets.

5) Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder

management skills with the ability to present insights to

clients and manage multiple projects.



Competencies 


1) Entrepreneurial orientation

2) Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal)

3) Innovative and collaborative behavior, team player

4) Customer centricity and paying attention to details

At PharmaACE, we believe that meaningful career growth comes from creating opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and broaden your experience.


As part of that commitment, we’re excited to introduce an Internal Job Posting (IJP) for onshore opportunities within our Forecasting team in the US.   • Minimum 1 year of tenure with the organization.
  • Strong knowledge of pharma forecasting and commercial drivers.

  • Familiarity with AI tools is an added advantage.
  • Proven ability to lead engagements/workstreams independently.
  • Strong communication skills.

Consultant PMR:

The Primary Market Research Consultant will support strategic market research initiatives by contributing to project execution, data analysis, and the development of high-quality deliverables that align with client objectives. The individual will collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams and clients to help drive actionable insights and ensure the successful delivery of impactful market research.
responsibilities:
• Support or lead end-to-end delivery of qualitative and quantitative primary market research (PMR) projects for clients in the Life Sciences industry.
  • Ensure alignment of research outputs with client objectives and timelines.
  • Contribute to the synthesis of data into strategic, actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional internal teams and client stakeholders to drive value through research.
  • Stay current on therapeutic area dynamics, competitive landscape, and market trends.
  • Support PMR (qualitative and quantitative) project execution, including questionnaire/discussion guide development, vendor coordination, and data quality checks.
  • Assist with secondary research and perform initial analysis of qualitative and quantitative data to support and contextualize primary research findings under the guidance of other team members.
  • Draft client-ready deliverables (e.g., toplines, slides, summary reports) with a focus on clear, insight-driven storytelling.
  • Actively contribute to and help facilitate discussions and brainstorming sessions to shape research insights and strategic implications.
  • Attend client meetings as needed to present and provide delivery support while facilitating coordination between multiple vertical and hybrid teams (onsite and remote).
  • Build therapeutic area expertise and strengthen knowledge of PMR methodologies.
qualifications:
• Advanced degree (MBA, Master’s, or equivalent) preferred from a recognized institute.
  • 4–8 years of professional experience in Primary Market Research with exposure to U.S.-based qualitative and quantitative market research projects in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
  • Strong expertise in pharmaceutical market research, with a deep understanding of methodologies, study design, data interpretation, and insight generation.
  • Proven experience managing end-to-end delivery of primary and secondary research initiatives across therapeutic areas and brand lifecycles.
  • Solid grasp of pharma commercialization dynamics and the ability to translate research findings into actionable recommendations for commercial teams.
  • Ability to lead and mentor cross-functional teams in hybrid (onsite + remote) settings, ensuring high-quality, timely execution.
  • Strong client-facing skills with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations, resolve issues, and build trusted relationships.
  • Willingness to be onsite at client locations as required.
